title: Pelopidas
summary: Raleigh names Pelopidas in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Pelopidas, the Theban Captaine sent Embassadour to Artaxerxes, whose reputation drew the King to grant the Thebans what they desired. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter XII, §. IV, sig. 454b–455a
